content: Jesús tu̱choda ja̱mu̱yada vichtyanchiy
Sajatyiiyada tu̱choda dityadoda tu̱chodata ruuvantiy:
“Jarichumuvichi̱ nusu̱yada rañi̱cha nu̱tyu ja̱mu nutyityu̱ jiryatiy sivaayadara vichtya jidyenu ja̱mu̱yadamu.
Su̱pa̱jada ji̱tariy jimyuchechimyi: Jirya̱numa naturyi musuchavay vichtyamuju̱. Musuchavay ji̱tamu̱y ne jiyaru̱yada variy.
Sajatyiiyada jpa̱jada ti̱ntiy: Ya̱numa tu̱chu ruuva musuchavay: Jdutyasaranuma ravyichtya. Ri̱vatyanimya̱ni̱ ra̱si̱ nu̱chusi̱, voca denu. Jdutyasaranuma ti̱ta̱ju̱ra. Varenuma vichtyamuju̱cu̱.
Musuchavay ji̱ta jiya̱da yavuryu̱tya̱damu, nu̱ jiya̱da yindimyu, nu̱ntiy jvaadyi ta̱ryu̱tya̱da na̱cho̱.
Rityevay ji̱ta rañi ju̱reda riy samuchechimyi, rirya̱rupanta̱da variryi, ru̱vamyu̱yada ti̱ta̱ju̱ riy, pattaryi.
Ja̱mu nutyityu̱ ji̱ta nique̱yada jaryi variy ranchiy, su̱pa̱jada ji̱ta variryi jichu̱tarumiy, rirya̱tidye parutamu̱ryi jvavye, rirya̱rupamyu̱y varirya rivyichajo.
Su̱teda ji̱ta ja̱mu nutyityu̱ variy ruuva jimyuchechimyi: Jdutyasaranuma vichtya, ramyusuvye ji̱ta vicha̱siy nicyara̱myi.
Jirya̱numa jiya nú̱qui nantaryaju̱myu, jirya̱numa musuy vichtyamuju̱riy ti̱ta̱ju̱ jiryatiy jirya̱sarye rumuriy.
Riya̱da ji̱ta samuchechimyi variy nú̱quiva, rirya̱tonuvejada variryi jicheryevye ti̱ta̱ju̱, nijya̱nvay nicyara̱myi, samivye jarye ruusa̱ju̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱. Rimyu̱chadeda varirya vichtya roriy.
Sajayadanumatiy ja̱mu nutyityu̱ sa̱tidye jnu̱ñuvi̱ riy musuchavay, sadiyada jasiy siva ti̱qui vanu, jiryatimyu̱ ne ja̱mu̱yada sujatyi̱ dañi̱.
Su̱tañuvi̱jada ji̱ta variy siva: Jaamyicyu, ¿nu̱tyuramusiy jijeyasiy jiyu, nu̱tyuramusiy? tama̱ ja̱mu̱yada sujatyi̱ jiñi̱cha, tama̱. Sama̱cho̱jada mitya vapuu variy ranchiy.

Jadchiy ji̱ta su̱teda ja̱mu nutyityu̱ ruuva jnu̱tyavantyi: Jirya̱numa puchumu̱y ti̱ta̱ju̱ni̱, jirya̱jatya̱siy variy bimuju̱ni̱, nupocudimuju̱. Jasidye ji̱ta rirya̱jna̱vya̱ nijya̱nvay variy, rirya̱su̱y ji̱ta jijya̱dajchantiy.
Ti̱quitya daryaju̱ riñi̱cha natuchavay, rajuuvatya ji̱ta jaryetasavadye.”
Criquinchiy, jiryatiy ja̱mu nutyityu̱ murichenutaniy nijya̱nvarya
Riya̱da ji̱ta Varyisévuvedabay variy riñiquetta̱dayu: “¿Nu̱tyuramusiy vurya̱ju̱riy taji niquejadivani̱ Jesús, nu̱tyuramusiy?”

Ru̱pa̱jada ji̱ta variy yisa̱ datyavavyedabay simu Jesús, Jeródesbe siityari̱vabe jarye ruusa̱ju̱. Ru̱teda ji̱ta variy siva Jesús: “Datyanu̱, nu̱dyetyara jiryatiy jiiñi̱ ji̱ta si̱tenu jtarya. Jiiñi̱ ji̱ta datyanusara si̱tenura Ju̱denu nú̱. Ne yinu̱y jaryi sami̱va̱ju̱ ti̱na̱cho̱, dañuma sani̱cha ti̱.
Ramuni̱, ya̱numa tu̱chu nu̱dyiva, nu̱tyura jijechipiya̱, nu̱tyura: ¿Samiryavidye vurya̱murichenura criquiy, jiryatiy ja̱mu nutyityu̱ Sésar murichenutaniy vuryi̱nu̱yadamusirya?”
Sadatya̱da ji̱ta Jesúsra rijechipiya̱jada jiyaro̱ju̱, su̱teda ji̱ta variy ruuva: “¿Ta̱ju̱ra jirye̱ntya rañiy, ta̱ju̱? Jiryi̱tu̱yadamu yitay.
Jirya̱dityanu rarya criquidye, ratatiy vurya̱murichenuracu̱.” Riryeda ji̱ta variy saju̱ra criquidye.
Su̱teda ji̱ta Jesús variy ruuva: “¿Chi̱ra sani̱cha criquitya̱sa jantyasi̱ day, chi̱? su̱ro̱ nu̱chara jarye, ¿ta̱ra rani̱cha daryamusidye, ta̱ra?”

Ru̱mutya̱jada ji̱tani̱: “Ja̱mu nutyityu̱ Sésar jantyasi̱.” Su̱teda jadchiy ruuvantiy: “Ramuni̱tiy jirya̱murichenu variñi̱ Sésar jiryatiy sabarya darya, jirya̱murichenuni̱ Ju̱denuntiy jiryatiy sabaryantidyerya.”
Rityuva̱chodanumatirya saniquejada, rityi̱tta̱da variñi̱. Rityocheda ji̱ta variñi̱ Jesús, riya̱da variy jadchiy.
Saadusévuvedabay jtaja̱dodani̱ Jesús diibyimusiy mi̱sadedanchiy

Ruuti̱jada Saadusévuvedabay variryundamu simuntiy. Ne ridyetaru̱ñu̱yada rimyi̱sa diibyimiñu̱day. Ruutaja̱doda ji̱ta variñi̱: “Datyanu̱, su̱teda ji̱ta Muyusésibe: Ti̱qui nijya̱mi̱tiy ra̱diiy dejsa̱, sataryi̱numa ra̱ja̱mu̱y variñi̱ savatura ma̱cho̱nu, sa̱tidye detuchu jityeryi̱bay jiyadaju̱ni̱.
Rivyichanu̱yada ji̱ta danu̱ju̱ñijyate nu̱ñi taryi̱veda nu̱quebyimu. Saja̱mu̱yada ji̱ta rimyunatyi̱ vaturajsa̱, sadiiyada ji̱ta mitya dejsa̱ sisa̱siy, sama̱cho̱ vatura variy sanijyu̱ vichi̱ju̱.
Daryaday savicha̱da sanijyu̱ vichi̱ntiy, nu̱numa rañi ja̱mu̱ntyiñi̱, nu̱ñi taryi̱veda, tamityi̱ sa̱ra̱ju̱, pattaryitye.
Tamityanuma ji̱ta sadiiyada vaturantidye, puutyitye.
Daryamusiy, rirya̱numatiy mi̱sa jidyiijyomusintyi, mi̱ju̱rate sa̱ma̱cho̱ vatura variy, tapi riñi ja̱mu̱yada ti̱ta̱ju̱musiñi̱ vatura.”
Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta Jesús variryi: “Jiryecyaramya̱ jijechipiya̱jadamu, jiryedyetyatya daryaju̱ra Ju̱denu niquejada, ne vinu sadatya̱da jarye.

Tapitya rirya̱tiy mi̱sa̱sumiy nijya̱nvay jidyiijyomusiy, ne rirya̱ja̱mu̱charayu, dantyamu̱y ne rirya̱ja̱mu̱tyanicharayu, jiryatiy rirye̱chasara daryaju̱ nu̱tyu Ju̱denu jpa̱vay daryá, jiryatiy jarichumu vichavaryi.
Ranchiy ji̱ta jiryatiy rimyi̱sasara jidyiijyomusiy, nu̱tyi jiryeñi niquema̱ catera nu̱charamuntirya, jiryatiy su̱teda Ju̱denu jiryivara:

content.text: Rañuma rañi̱cha Avurá̱bay Ju̱denu, Isácubay Ju̱denu jarye, Jacóbubay Ju̱denu jaryentiy.

content: ¿Va̱ diibyimiy riñi̱chacay? ¡Jnu̱vyentya riñi̱cha jasidye! Ni̱ni̱ta diibyimiy Ju̱denu day, nu̱tyi ni̱ni̱ ji̱ta sani̱cha jnu̱vye Ju̱denu.”
Rityuva̱chodanumatiy nijya̱nvarya saniquejada, rityi̱tta̱da varirya sadatyadoda.
Miryara vichasara jaryinra Ju̱denu datyadoda, mirya
Rityuva̱chodanumatiy Varyisévuvedabarya jiryatiy sandasadeda Jesús riy Saadusévuvedabay, riintye̱ryadeda ji̱ta variy simuyu.
Ti̱qui rityenu jiryatiy niquejada datyi̱ni̱, sani jtaja̱doda ji̱ta jantya̱daju̱ variñi̱ Jesús: “Datyanu̱, ¿miryara vichasara jaryinra Ju̱denu datyadoda ti̱ta̱ju̱ su̱teda cabyimu, mirya?”
Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta jasiñi̱: “Vurya̱ma̱ va̱tasara ti̱ta̱ju̱ vu̱jechityani̱ Vu̱ntyityu̱ Ju̱denu, ti̱ta̱ju̱ vuryi̱ntuta jarye, ti̱ta̱ju̱ vu̱jechipiya̱jadata jarye risa̱ju̱.
Rani̱ ji̱ta jaryinra datyadoda jiryatiy munatyara.
Daraju̱jyu̱ datyadoda ji̱ta nu̱tyu ratiy daryantiy: Vurya̱ma̱ va̱tasarani̱ vu̱tyuunu vichi̱ntidye, nu̱tyu vu̱vya̱tasaratiy daryantidyevyu̱y.
Jirya daraju̱y datyadodamusiy ru̱ndayada ti̱ta̱ju̱ su̱teda Ju̱denu, jiryatiy su̱teda Muyusésibemyusirya, jijyu̱ tu̱chuvabe jtomusiy jarye risa̱ju̱.”
¿Chi̱denu sani̱cha Ju̱denu jaryeti̱, chi̱denu?
Riintye̱ryadedamu, sitaja̱doda Jesús Varyisévuvedayu: “¿Nu̱tyura jiryejechipiya̱ sanchiy Ju̱denu jaryeti̱, nu̱tyura? ¿Chi̱ denu sani̱cha, chi̱ denu?” Ru̱teda ji̱ta siva: “Davyíbe jasi̱.”
Su̱teda ji̱ta variy ruuva: “Nu̱tyuramusiy variy su̱teda Davyíbe, Ju̱denu Jnutumusiy siva: ¡Nutyityu̱! Su̱teda daryaju̱:

content.text: Su̱teda ji̱ta Ju̱denu siva rayntyityu̱: Ya̱ma̱sa rayntyityudamyuju̱, jasicha̱ra̱ju̱tiy ra̱vuunutaniryi jimyityasimyi.

content: Jiryatiy Davyíbeñuma ji̱ta jtay jintyityu̱ntidyeñi̱, ¿nu̱tyichiy sa̱cha variy sa̱si̱, nu̱tyichiy?”
Ne vana̱y ti̱ jmutya̱jada variy tarani̱, dantyamu̱y ne ruutaja̱nuru̱yada tara ju̱na̱y jadchiñu̱nñi̱.
